entities.name: PMID:27500765
observations: In a murine acute myocardial injury model, continuous apelin-13 infusion (0.5 μg/g/day) started one week after injury and continued four weeks; LVEF was maintained versus saline and MRI peri-infarct and scar volumes decreased.
LVEF changed from 21.9% to 23.1% with apelin-13 versus 23.5% to 16.9% with saline (p=0.02); reported advantage persisted at week 9 after infusion cessation.
From weeks 1 to 4, peri-infarct volume fell 15.1% to 7.4% and scar volume fell 34.3% to 25.1% with apelin-13 (p=0.02).

entities.name: Apelin-13
observations: Continuous infusion in murine myocardial injury was associated with decreased peri-infarct/scar volumes and maintained LVEF versus saline in PMID:27500765.

entities.name: Apelin-13 infarct salvage
observations: In mice with severe acute myocardial injury, apelin-13 begun one week after injury reduced MRI-estimated peri-infarct volume from 15.1% to 7.4% and scar volume from 34.3% to 25.1%; LVEF rose 21.9% to 23.1%, while saline controls fell 23.5% to 16.9%.
